fact: On 22 June 2023 the Ministry of ICT launched the EEC and EPTC Power Line Optic Fiber Infrastructure project, which the EPTC said will connect Eswatini to the rest of the world via the Motraco infrastructure (the power-line network of the Eswatini, Mozambican and South African state utilities' joint venture).
title: EPTC LAUNCHES FIRST OPTICAL FIBER NETWORK
